name: When should I consider upgrading my bathroom's electrical panel?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider upgrading my bathroom's electrical panel?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider upgrading your bathroom's electrical panel if you are experiencing frequent tripped breakers, if your panel is outdated (e.g., fuse box), or if you plan to add several new high-power appliances like a steam shower, jetted tub, or dedicated hair styling station. An insufficient panel can lead to safety hazards and limit your ability to add modern amenities. Frasheski Construction assesses your current electrical capacity as part of any significant bathroom renovation, especially in older homes common in areas like Albany or El Cerrito, to ensure your new systems operate safely and efficiently.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider a panel upgrade for frequent tripped breakers, outdated panels, or when adding high-power appliances to ensure safety and capacity.
